title: Reliability report: A-Identity
subject: A-Identity
scope: Covers only the two A-Identity Algorand x402 endpoints listed below (pay_check and risk_check). It says nothing about A-Identity's other chains, products or endpoints.
method: Independent, unpaid probes of each endpoint about every 3 minutes (mean interval 180 s). Uptime = probes where the endpoint was reachable and not a 5xx. Correct-402 = of the probes where the endpoint made a payment decision (402, or an unpaid 2xx), the share that correctly answered 402. Score = 0.6 x uptime + 0.4 x correct-402 - a latency penalty (up to 20). A sustained outage is 2+ consecutive failed probes. Full definitions: https://github.com/cameron4316/x402-oracle-server#reading-the-result
disclaimer: An observational measurement of past behaviour over the stated window. It is not a guarantee of future availability or performance, and not an audit, certification or endorsement.
